text:
ivy (Design): Quick check on the trace minimap + header changes. Figma: https://figma.redwood/minimap-a11y. Main asks: span discoverability, export header mismatch, and compact-mode copy/contrast.

rahim (Product): Users keep hitting CSV parsing issues because headers differ from UI copy.

sora (Eng-runtime): Current minimap is SVG-only. Don't want 200 tab stops; propose a single focus hotspot + arrow-key navigation. Announce via aria-live: "Span 6 of 34: auth.verify, duration 28ms, correlation id 0x4f2".

lina (Accessibility): Single-focus is good. Ensure live text spells the correlation id exactly and include role=button for the hotspot. Provide visible focus ring when keyboard nav is active.

ivy (Design): Visual idea: show halo only in keyboard mode (toggle body class). Tooltips should use the same human copy as the UI. Export modal will show machine keys.

sora (Eng-runtime): I'll add {displayName, exportKey} per column so exports use snake_case but modal shows mapping. Persist last-used format per workspace.

ben (Eng-SRE): Export JSON/HAR/CSV must include correlation_id and span_id. For structured stacks include a full_stack blob and top_app_frame columns so our parsers don't break.

lina (Accessibility): Icon-only "copy id" needs aria-label and a live-region confirmation like "Correlation id 0x4f2 copied". In expanded header show text "Copy ID"; compact mode can be icon-only with sr-only label. Also ensure dropdowns trap focus.

ivy (Design): Copy tweaks: change "Download snapshot" -> "Save snapshot (PNG)", "Export events (CSV)", "Export structured trace (JSON)". Add small "Column mapping" table in export modal: e.g., "Duration -> duration_ms".

sora (Eng-runtime): Perf note: precompute minimap bounding boxes on render; hover/keyboard should only update selectedIndex. No layout thrash.

rahim (Product): Add analytics events: minimap.keyboard_nav, export.format_selected, correlation.copy. Helps measure adoption.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: trace-ui/minimap-a11y v1.0 -> staging 2026-03-30T12:00:00Z :rocket:

ivy (Design): I'll post a short PR checklist (a11y + SRE sign-off) after I update Figma. Thanks everyone!
